objective: Expand a visual foundation curriculum with explicitly scoped concepts, ten reviewed images per teaching contract, dependency-respecting order, and independently verified immutable manifests.

inputs.commission_contracts: One row per unambiguous teaching sense, including stable ID, display label, part of speech, teaching sense, visual contract, required image count, and source claim IDs.
inputs.missing_prerequisite_claims: One evidence-bearing row per required dependency edge, with target contract and component relation.
inputs.selected_asset_ledgers: Append-only accepted rows with unique slot ID, contract identity, local path, SHA-256, review disposition, and provenance.
inputs.additional_dependency_edges: Explicit conservative edges for obvious components introduced by a sense-disambiguating label. Morphology, loose association, and upper-bound decompositions are excluded.

contract_policy: Every display label has exactly one intended teaching sense.
Noun and verb homographs must not share an undifferentiated byte label; verbs normally use an infinitive label beginning with 'to '.
Countability is never inferred mechanically and nouns do not receive automatic articles.
When more than one interpretation is possible, select one teaching sense before image review and quantify images invalidated by that choice.
Prefer a single lexical label. Use a phrase only when needed to disambiguate the teaching contract, and audit any obvious content-word prerequisites that the phrase introduces.
Derivational or merely related forms such as locate/location and migrate/migration are not prerequisites by default.
Direct compound components such as back/backpack are prerequisites unless evidence shows the component is already taught in the required sense.

ordered_pipeline.action: Audit the requested curriculum for absent direct compound components and other obvious lexical prerequisites; resolve every retained component to one teaching sense.
Search the local reviewed image pool first and allocate fitting candidates without exceeding the exact slot requirement.
Search external dataset metadata for unresolved slots, download only bounded candidates, and preserve source identity and URL provenance. Metadata is never pixel acceptance.
Review visible pixels against the exact teaching sense and visual contract. The image must be direct, salient, coherent, and not rely on a caption that merely spells the answer.
Generate only unresolved slots through the bounded executor ladder. Prompts must be simple enough for Flux on the first attempt and must encode the intended visual evidence directly.
Merge accepted ledgers by slot, verify hashes and files, require exactly ten images per contract, and enforce the image-reuse cap.
Add claim-driven and conservative obvious-label dependency edges, topologically sort all contracts, and rewrite ordered slots and sequence positions.
Re-audit newly introduced labels for further direct compound prerequisites. Do not commission morphology, sense qualifiers, or upper-bound decompositions merely because a token can be split.
Reload the folded manifests, verify every distinct file by SHA-256, exact per-contract counts, unique labels and slots, dependency order, serialized dependency lists, and reuse limits.

generation_ladder: Flux fresh retry with the same clear contract
Flux retry with one evidence-based prompt correction
terminal report naming the word, intended meaning, and remaining image deficit

review_policy.acceptance_authority: Luna pixel review, subject to an explicit recorded operator override.
review_policy.luna_semantics: Admission, target verdicts, uncertainty, watermark, and material defects determine usability. A stylistic quality note alone is not an automatic hard rejection when admission is usable and every target is present.
review_policy.human_override: An operator may accept or reject a visible candidate explicitly. Preserve Luna's result, the override reason, actor, timestamp, source hash, and final disposition.
review_policy.duplicate_images: Exact image reuse is allowed up to four total uses when every placement fits its teaching contract.
review_policy.writing_route: Concepts whose evidence intrinsically depends on legible writing may route directly to OpenAI ImageGen after recording the Flux limitation; trying local Flux first remains permitted.
review_policy.abstract_concepts: Use a consistent visible convention and diversify realizations. For indefinite time, examples include continuous seasonal transitions, repeated subjects across time, endless routes, and space-time visualizations.

mechanical_invariants: Every teaching contract has exactly ten accepted image slots.
Every display label is unique after Unicode-preserving casefold and whitespace normalization.
Every accepted row has a readable local file whose SHA-256 matches the manifest.
No exact image hash appears more than four times in the folded curriculum.
Every dependency edge points from a lower final ordinal to a higher final ordinal.
Every contract and asset depends_on list exactly matches the dependency-edge graph.
No contract or asset retains a missing dependency at training handoff.
Training-ready is false when any invariant fails.

commands.audit_acquisition: python3 -m image_registry.foundation_corpus_expansion audit-acquisition --contracts COMMISSION_CONTRACTS.jsonl --ledger LOCAL_SELECTED.jsonl --ledger METADATA_SELECTED.jsonl --ledger GENERATED_ACCEPTED.jsonl --images-per-contract 10 --max-image-reuse 4 --output ACQUISITION_AUDIT.json
